maria: FYI deploy (canary) showing a weird perf wobble on causal workloads. throughput down ~22% on a subset of requests. looks like kernel-picker is flipping between flashv2/flashv3 per-microbatch when head_dim==22

maria: logs snippet:
```
kernel_picker: select flashv3 for seqlen=512 head_dim=22 causal=true
kernel_picker: fallback flashv2 for seqlen=512 head_dim=22 causal=true reason=tiling_mismatch
kernel_picker: select flashv3 for seqlen=512 head_dim=22 causal=true
```

karthik: Oof. is this limited to causal path? non-causal stable?

maria: non-causal steady. only seeing oscillation on causal. also KV cache hit latency spikes when flip happens.

selena: sounds like bucketization boundary + causal tiling rule. headdim 22 falls into a weird fractional bucket for flashv3 heuristics. v2/v3 decision is sequence-length + headmod dependent. we probably forgot to add a deterministic tie-breaker for small odd heads.

jake: can you paste profiler (nvprof/trace) for a toggling run? want to see kernel id + launch timings.

maria: pasted cpu timeline and nvtx trace (short):
```
[0.000] schedule microbatch 1 -> flashv3.launch (12.4ms)
[0.012] microbatch 1 -> kvcache write (1.7ms)
[0.020] microbatch 2 -> flashv2.launch (9.1ms)
[0.030] microbatch 2 -> kvcache write (3.4ms)
```

maria: notice kv write doubles when path flips. likely different post-kernel memory layout triggers extra copy.

karthik: repro steps? need deterministic test to validate autotuner fix.

maria: small repro script (python pseudo):
```
for _ in range(1000):
  client.generate(model='rwd-open-xxl', seq_len=512, head_dim=22, causal=True, batch=4)
```

selena: quick mitigation: add a hysteresis window in kernel-picker so it doesn't switch within N microbatches (N=16) and add a headdim remapping rule: map odd headdims <24 -> 24 for the flashv3 selector only. that keeps performance but preserves accuracy because weights are unaffected (only kernel tiling).

jake: agree on short-term pin. we should also add a logging counter when picker flips so we can alert earlier.

maria: I can rollback canary to pin flashv2 for causal headdim<24 now. want to run an A/B with hysteresis enabled in staging.

runtime-bot: Deploy: canary rollback started by maria at 3076543230. CI: all checks passed. :gear:

karthik: long-term: update autotuner to be architecture-aware (SM90 vs SM80) and include a tiny calibration phase per-worker on boot to map headdim->best kernel. store calibration + TTL. also consider KV layout normalization (so post-kernel memory writes are same shape for both kernels).

selena: agree. also we should add a unit in the autotuner that simulates causal pad behavior — lots of regressions happen because causal kernels expect different pad alignment than non-causal.

jake: i'll run a quick perf sweep on staging with headdim in {16,18,20,22,24} and seqlen {128,512,1024} and post numbers.

maria: plan: 1) rollback canary (done) 2) add flip-counter alert + short hysteresis (hotfix) 3) run sweep and implement headdim remap + boot calibration (next sprint). tagging @karthik for autotuner changes.

karthik: sounds good. please include a metric for "kv_write_latency" and %batches_with_picker_flip. want dashboards before we re-roll.

maria: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
